tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and slide background, everywhere. Warm stone, never pure white.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, table rules, card borders and quiet fills behind tags.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Stronger rules, chart axes and outline icons (3:1 on paper). Not for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, display type and metrics, on paper, mist, mist-deep and sage.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy on paper, mist, mist-deep and sage.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and mono labels, on paper and mist.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Card and callout fills: snapshot blocks, quotes, highlighted panels.

tokens.name: mist-deep
tokens.usage: A full-bleed accent background for a section or slide. Use sparingly, once per piece.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: A second full-bleed background, for outcomes or 'what we learnt' moments. Never beside mist-deep.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The accent ink: links, key numbers, primary buttons and the one path that matters in a diagram.

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a slate fill, such as a primary button.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, "Courier New", monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Inter Semibold for anything that leads a page or slide.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Turning Reddit noise into brand intelligence
styles.usage: Cover titles and section openers. One per page or slide.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Impact numbers. Set in ink, or slate when it is the one highlight, with a label style line beneath.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: What we learnt from concept testing

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A focused look at the problems I've shaped end-to-end, from research and strategy through to ship.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and slide body text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Led a two-phase initiative to migrate the entire Knowledge Base onto HubSpot's content platform.
styles.usage: Running text on the web and in docs.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Supporting detail, table cells, resume bullets.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for the designer's-notes voice. Small sizes only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows above headings and labels under metrics. Always written in capitals, in ink-muted or slate.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, footnotes, dates and sources.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside tags and between a label and its heading.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens; the minimum side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between a heading and the content it introduces.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between related sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gaps between major sections; slide margins.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of a page hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, images in case studies.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large hero images and feature panels only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Skill tags and status chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards only, when a hairline border is not enough. Prefer line borders.
